description: The pt / pt-PT half of the clause. GeneratedCldrPluralData keeps pt and pt-PT as distinct cardinal rule sets: pt's one-rule is `i = 0..1` while pt-PT's is `i = 1 and v = 0`, so the two disagree at 0 (pt ONE, pt-PT OTHER) and at 1.5 (pt ONE, pt-PT OTHER) and nowhere else. Three keys route three different donors: Boxes.PtOnly makes pt the donor for a pt-PT request through the CLDR parent chain, Boxes.PtPtOnly makes pt-PT reachable for a bare pt request through the tiebreaker limb of localeFallbackCandidates, and Boxes.EnOnly makes the fallback locale en the donor for both. Tiebreakers are MANDATORY here because pt and pt-PT share the primary language code 'pt', and DefaultStrings requires the list to be an exact permutation of the loaded pt-language locales; 'pt' is listed first so a bare pt request still selects pt itself.

Boxes.EnOnly.commentary: Only the two categories English has, so a port that evaluated this donor entry under pt or pt-PT rules would select MANY at 1000000 and find no branch.
